question_record.context: A security incident involving internal phishing was detected where a user named Lucas Grey with an email Lucas Grey@niseko.alpineskihouse.co was observed to have sent phishing emails from their device to recipients inside the organization. This user account might have been compromised as part of a lateral movement attempt by an attacker. The malicious URL involved in the phishing email was `http://ym018491661.wittytree-b6f239d6.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io/`.
question_record.question: What is the recipient email address that received the malicious URL in the phishing email sent during this incident?
solution: The account with email `Nina Sullivan@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` was observed sending phishing emails internally, suggesting possible account compromise.
The email account `santiago@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` received emails containing malicious URLs, which were later removed.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Derived_Email'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
